coordinates: X across the panel; Y above the panel underside; Z along the panel. Geometry uses one scene unit per millimetre. Dimensions below are X × Y × Z unless noted.

parts.note: Panel and fixing screws from the enclosure STEP assembly. The drawing gives 12.88 × 14.75 in and 0.075 in steel thickness. Electrical bonding is separate from the mounting screws.

parts.note: Long blue body uses the current 216 × 63 × 47 mm specification. The older ELOG manual gives 203 × 69 × 58 mm. Measure the photographed instrument before finalizing. Ports, feet and grip details are visual approximations; plug space is additional.

parts.note: DENT HSC mini hinged example, Ø10.2 mm aperture. Its catalog envelope illustrates the white split-core style in the photos; this does not identify your CT model or range. One hot conductor passes through once; arrow points toward output.

parts.name: Q0 · single operating breaker
parts.note: Carling CA1-B0-24-615-121-DG candidate: one pole, 15 A, 50/60 Hz medium delay, panel mounting, 240 VAC application / UL 489 + CSA option. Body envelope excludes rear studs (about 13.6 mm) and front handle (13.72 mm). A supported insulating mounting insert and guarded terminals are required. Confirm the exact variant, supply, total load, inrush and switching duty before ordering. This replaces the earlier DIN-breaker mounting concept.

parts.name: Fv · voltage-tap fuse holder
parts.note: Bussmann CHCC1DU single Class CC holder candidate; catalog drawing, p.145. Holder rating is not the fuse rating. Select a compatible Class CC fuse only after the voltage leads, fault level and inrush are checked. Verify conductor and tinned-end acceptance; adapt through an approved terminal if necessary.

parts.name: JL / JN / JPE distribution
parts.note: Each WAGO 221-415 body uses the manufacturer CAD dimensions, 29.80 × 8.15 × 18.30 mm. Three separate groups sit in illustrative carriers with guards. Final conductor acceptance, PE bonding suitability and capacity for extra metalwork bonds require review. A second PE connector is bridged to the first to provide the outlet-box bond and spare bonding capacity. Model carrier is 35 × 16.9 × 52.8 mm; confirm purchased carrier drawing.

parts.note: Leviton 5261: 27 mm depth, 103.2 mm yoke height, 33.3 mm width. Side-mounted on a supported insulating insert with a RACO rear box and Leviton single-receptacle wallplate. Actual mounting stack, rear wiring and wall thickness still require a dry fit.

parts.note: RACO 670RAC / retail 8670 handy box. Uses 2.188 in actual depth × 4 in height × 2.125 in width. Leviton 84004-40 faceplate covers the single round receptacle. Metal box/cover need a dedicated PE bond. Wall support, opening and wire-entry fittings are proposed, not fabrication dimensions.

parts.note: Exterior black body is estimated as 65 mm tall × 42 mm wide × 42 mm projection; blades are inside XA. Existing factory cable re-enters via its own entry. Verify the adapter label, plug direction, actual dimensions and retention. No replacement adapter is specified.

parts.note: 35 × 7.5 mm DIN profile, proposed 100 mm cut length for Fv only, with end stops and a dedicated bond. Q0 now mounts on the front panel.

parts.note: Mains cord entries use an approximate Ø27 × 37 mm M20-style envelope; the mains-entry candidate is 1427NCGM20B. Cable outside diameter, wall thickness, sealing and strain relief determine the actual part. USB/DC need an entry that accepts the existing terminated cable; coloured rings mark proposed penetration locations only.

parts.name: Blue adapters & retained lead slack
parts.note: Three blue pigtails feed L1 hot, L2 neutral and N neutral. The visible coils reserve space for the full leads; they do not certify storage of each 2 m lead or minimum bend radius.
